generate_online_numba_ewma_func: generate a numba-jitted online exponentially weighted moving average function with configurable nogil and parallel options
create_EWMMeanState: create an EWMMeanState object to track exponentially weighted moving average state with configurable center-of-mass, adjust, and ignore_na parameters
run_ewm_EWMMeanState: run the EWMMeanState.run_ewm method to compute online exponentially weighted means given weighted averages, deltas, and a numba ewm function
reset_EWMMeanState: reset the EWMMeanState to initial weights and clear the last EWM result for reuse with new data batches
build_online_ewma: build an online exponentially weighted moving average computation pipeline using numba-jitted functions and stateful tracking
